title: The Tin of Honey Shortbread
youtube_title: The Tin of Honey Shortbread | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a favorite treat can make the taste feel bigger, not smaller.
summary: Theo means to eat a whole tin of honey shortbread alone on the dunes, then opens it for Auntie and the lighthouse keeper, who climb up from the boats with empty hands.
